systems.water: Incoming pressurised + meter from Säterdalsvägen main
systems.foul_sewer: Gravity to main; fall ≈1:15 (house ~1.7 m above main over ~26 m) ≫ typ. min ~1:100 — no pump
systems.stormwater: Roof → soakaway on permeable Isälvssediment (esker), separated from foul; infiltration to verify
systems.electricity: Grid service → main panel; PV DC→inverter→panel; battery-ready; EV point at carport
systems.heating: Ground-source heat pump (bergvärme) + tank → hydronic underfloor; rock ~9 m (SGU, variable); permit near Övre Svärtinge groundwater body
systems.ventilation: Balanced FTX heat recovery (typ. ≥75%); intake NE-shaded, extract wet rooms + kitchen
systems.smart_meter: Sub-metering + leak/temp sensors + PV/heat-pump telemetry — the digital-twin data feed
